newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 25.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Ivory Coast holds talks with winning prequalifying bidders to build 300-400 MW gas-fed thermal powerstation in Abidjan. Second round bid deadline set for April 30 with construction scheduled for July 1998.
- Government tax and treasury employees' heed first day of two day strike called from Monday by finance workers' union SYNAFIG.
- Man accused of being a sorcerer who made penises shrink or vanish dies after being attacked by a crowd on March 8. Death toll at least five after scare swept country in early March.
- Ivory Coast and European Union sign 17 billion CFA agricultural reform credit package under Lome Convention aimed at cocoa, coffee and livestock sectors
